matches.rationale: The ground truth describes a fundamental error in treating galaxies as being in a different frame than the observer, which manifests as spurious extra (1+z) factors propagating through the distance/aberration derivation. Finding 1 explicitly identifies this double-counting of relative-motion/aberration effects already built into the FLRW formula, and Finding 2 shows the same erroneous extra (1+z)^2 factor breaking the Etherington relation downstream, both stemming from the same root frame-mismatch error.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Directly identifies the double-counting of relative-motion (aberration) effects causing an erroneous extra (1+z) factor, matching the core frame-mismatch defect.
Shows the same type of spurious (1+z)^2 factor propagating into the Etherington relation, a downstream consequence of the same root computational error.
Raises a distinct, technically separate concern about covariant position vectors in GR unrelated to the frame-mismatch defect in the ground truth.
Points to a dimensional inconsistency in the intensity definition, a separate issue not tied to the reference-frame corruption described in the ground truth.
